repos_data.description: Facebook's branch of the Oracle MySQL database. This includes MyRocks.
MySQL Shell is a command line scriptable shell for MySQL, with support for logical backups, InnoDB Cluster management and more. It supports SQL, JavaScript and Python.

MySQL Workbench is a unified visual tool for database architects, developers, and DBAs. MySQL Workbench provides data modeling, SQL development, and comprehensive administration tools for server configuration, user administration, backup, and much more.
MySQL Utilities is a set of easy-to-use scripts intended to make working with MySQL servers easier.
HammerDB: The industry standard open-source database benchmark
A sample MySQL database with an integrated test suite, used to test your applications and database servers
MySQL Connector/C++ is a MySQL database connector for C++. It lets you develop C++ and C applications that connect to MySQL Server.

MariaDB server is a community developed fork of MySQL server. Started by core members of the original MySQL team, MariaDB actively works with outside developers to deliver the most featureful, stable, and sanely licensed open SQL server in the industry.

MySQL Connector/Python is implementing the MySQL Client/Server protocol completely in Python. No MySQL libraries are needed, and no compilation is necessary to run this Python DB API v2.0 compliant driver. Documentation & Download: http://dev.mysql.com/doc/connector-python/en
A tool for syncing LDAP users to MySQL or MariaDB users

repo_meta_data.description: MySQL Server, the world's most popular open source database, and MySQL Cluster, a real-time, open source transactional database.
